title.zh: 中国特色社会主义新时代

clips.send: 2023. A home-built airliner carries passengers. On 28 May 2023 the C919 — a passenger jet designed and built in China, about the size of a Boeing 737 — flew its first commercial flight, from Shanghai to Beijing.

clips.send: 2049. Second centenary goal. By the middle of the century — the 100th birthday of the People’s Republic in 2049 — build China into a great modern socialist country that is prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, harmonious and beautiful.

clips.send: 2017. The 19th National Congress: a “new era”. In October 2017 the 19th National Congress declared that socialism with Chinese characteristics had entered a new era. The country’s main challenge had changed: people now wanted a better life, but development was still unbalanced and inadequate.

clips.send: Tianhe core module. 天和 Tiānhé, “Harmony of the Heavens” — the control centre and main living room. The first piece in orbit. About 16.6 m long — roughly a city bus and a half. It steers the whole station and holds the sleeping quarters, kitchen and exercise bike. Its round “node” at the front has ports where other modules and spacecraft dock.

clips.send: 2019. First landing on the Moon’s far side. On 3 January 2019 the Chang’e-4 probe (嫦娥 Cháng’é is the Moon goddess of Chinese legend) made the first soft landing in history on the far side of the Moon — the side we never see from Earth. On 1 October the People’s Republic of China turned 70.

clips.send: Tianzhou cargo spacecraft. 天舟 Tiānzhōu, “Heavenly Vessel” — the delivery truck. No crew on board: it flies and docks automatically. It brings food, water, experiments and rocket fuel — several tonnes at a time. When its job is done it is filled with trash and burns up in the atmosphere.

clips.send: 2024. Samples from the Moon’s far side. In June 2024 Chang’e-6 brought back the first samples ever collected from the far side of the Moon. On 1 October the People’s Republic of China turned 75.

clips.send: 2018. Written into the Constitution. In March 2018 China’s national legislature, the National People’s Congress, amended the Constitution. Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era was written into it. 2018 was also the 40th anniversary of “reform and opening up”.

clips.send: 2015. Five ideas for how to grow. In October 2015 the CPC put forward a new development philosophy (新发展理念) in five words: innovation, coordination, green, openness and sharing. Growth should be smarter, more balanced, cleaner, more connected to the world, and fairer.

clips.send: 2016. “China’s Sky Eye” opens. In September 2016 FAST — a radio telescope 500 metres wide, as big as about 30 soccer fields — began listening to the universe from a natural bowl in the hills of Guizhou Province. Its nickname is “China’s Sky Eye” (中国天眼).

clips.send: Wentian lab module. 问天 Wèntiān, “Quest for the Heavens” — a science lab and backup control room. Mostly life-science experiments: how plants, cells and small animals do in weightlessness. It has extra sleeping cabins, so six astronauts can be aboard during a crew handover. It also has its own airlock for spacewalks.

clips.send: 2014. The “Four Comprehensives” strategy. In 2014 the leadership put forward a four-part strategy called the “Four Comprehensives” (四个全面 sì gè quánmiàn). “Comprehensive” means “in every respect”.

clips.send: 2020. A hard year with big finishes. In 2020 China fought the COVID-19 epidemic. By November the last poor counties had been lifted out of poverty. The BeiDou-3 satellite navigation system — China’s own GPS — went global, and China’s economy passed 100 trillion yuan for the first time.
clips.text: 2020. A hard year with big finishes. In 2020 China fought the COVID-19 epidemic. By November the last poor counties had been lifted out of poverty. The BeiDou-3 satellite navigation system — China’s own GPS — went global, and China’s economy passed 100 trillion yuan for the first time.

clips.send: 2022. The 20th National Congress: Chinese modernisation. In October 2022 the 20th National Congress set the central task for the years ahead: build a great modern socialist country and advance national rejuvenation through a Chinese path to modernisation (中国式现代化). That year the Tiangong space station was completed.
clips.text: 2022. The 20th National Congress: Chinese modernisation. In October 2022 the 20th National Congress set the central task for the years ahead: build a great modern socialist country and advance national rejuvenation through a Chinese path to modernisation (中国式现代化). That year the Tiangong space station was completed.

clips.send: Shenzhou crewed spacecraft. 神舟 Shénzhōu, “Divine Vessel” — the astronauts’ ride up and down. It carries three astronauts. Shenzhou-12 took the first crew to Tiangong in June 2021. In 2003 Shenzhou-5 carried Yang Liwei, making China the third country to send a person into space on its own. Crews now stay about six months, then hand over to the next crew in orbit.

clips.send: 2012. The 18th National Congress and the “Chinese Dream”. In November 2012 the Communist Party of China (CPC) held its 18th National Congress — a meeting held every five years that sets the country’s direction. Xi Jinping (习近平 Xí Jìnpíng) became General Secretary. Days later he named a goal: the “Chinese Dream” (中国梦 Zhōngguó mèng).

clips.send: 2013. “Targeted” help for poor villages. In November 2013, visiting Shibadong (十八洞), a mountain village in Hunan Province, Xi Jinping put forward “targeted poverty alleviation” (精准扶贫 jīngzhǔn fúpín): find out exactly who is poor and why, then help household by household.

clips.send: 2035. Goal for 2035. Step one of the plan set by the 19th and 20th Congresses: by 2035, basically achieve socialist modernisation.

clips.send: Mengtian lab module. 梦天 Mèngtiān, “Dreaming of the Heavens” — the last big piece. Mostly physics experiments in microgravity, including very precise atomic clocks. When it docked, the station reached its T shape — three modules, about 66 tonnes. That is about one-sixth the mass of the ISS, which was built by 15 countries.

clips.send: 2021. First centenary goal reached. On 1 July 2021, the CPC’s 100th birthday, Xi Jinping announced that China had built a “moderately prosperous society in all respects” (全面建成小康社会; xiǎokāng means “fairly well-off”). In February China had declared complete victory in the fight against poverty.

clips.send: 2012年。中共十八大与中国梦。2012年11月，中共十八大召开。随后习近平当选为中共中央总书记。在参观《复兴之路》展览时，他提出：实现中华民族伟大复兴，就是中华民族近代以来最伟大的梦想。

clips.send: 梦天实验舱。空间站的最后一个大型舱段。主要开展微重力科学实验，配有高精度原子钟。梦天舱对接后，空间站形成“T”字基本构型，三舱总质量约66吨。2022年底，中国空间站全面建成。

clips.send: 2035年。2035年目标。十九大、二十大确定的“两步走”第一步：到2035年基本实现社会主义现代化。

clips.send: 2022年。中共二十大：中国式现代化。2022年10月，中共二十大召开，提出新时代新征程的中心任务：团结带领全国各族人民全面建成社会主义现代化强国、实现第二个百年奋斗目标，以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴。同年，天宫空间站全面建成。

clips.send: 2018年。载入宪法。2018年3月，十三届全国人大一次会议通过宪法修正案，把习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想载入宪法。这一年也是改革开放40周年。

clips.send: 天和核心舱。空间站的管理和控制中心，航天员的主要生活舱。最先发射入轨的舱段，全长约16.6米。负责空间站的统一管理和控制，内有睡眠区、厨房和锻炼设备。前端的节点舱有多个对接口，供其他舱段和飞船对接。

clips.send: 神舟载人飞船。接送航天员往返天地的飞船。可乘坐3名航天员。2021年6月，神舟十二号把首批航天员送入天宫空间站。2003年，杨利伟乘神舟五号飞天，中国成为世界上第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。现在每个乘组在轨驻留约6个月，并在轨道上与下一乘组交接。

clips.send: 2021年。第一个百年奋斗目标实现。2021年7月1日，在庆祝中国共产党成立100周年大会上，习近平宣告：我们实现了第一个百年奋斗目标，在中华大地上全面建成了小康社会。此前的2月，我国宣布脱贫攻坚战取得全面胜利。

clips.send: 2020年。决战决胜之年。2020年，全国人民抗击新冠肺炎疫情。11月，全国832个贫困县全部脱贫摘帽。北斗三号全球卫星导航系统正式开通，国内生产总值首次突破100万亿元。
